prompt: Research one structural silver-deficit investment idea.

inputs.seed_claim: Structural silver deficits and falling available inventories may create upside asymmetry in metal exposure, low-cost producers, and streamers, with photovoltaic thrifting and substitution as key offsets.
inputs.drivers: Industrial demand from electronics, AI hardware, EVs, grid, and PV; investment flows; constrained mine supply; recycling; real rates; USD; precious-metals risk appetite.
inputs.value_chain: PAAS, AG, HL and other producers; WPM streamers; SLV physical exposure; PV, EV, grid, and electronics users; silver-light CdTe substitutes such as FSLR.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed requires persistent deficits, tightening bullion liquidity, investment inflows, and free-cash-flow conversion at low-AISC miners and streamers.
inputs.invalidation: PV thrifting, recycling, investment outflows, higher real yields or USD, hedging, mining costs, jurisdiction, capex, or valuation.
